title: Fix monthly total volume calculations across workout, reps, and time habits

requirements.text: Fix the monthly total volume calculation so it correctly reflects total volume for each habit in the selected month using these formulas: (1) for workout-style numeric volumes, monthly total = (per-completion volume) × (number of completed days); (2) for reps-only habits, monthly total = (per-completion reps) × (number of completed days); (3) for time-based habits, monthly total = (per-completion time) × (number of completed days) computed in seconds when a time string is available, then formatted back to M:SS. Ensure this works consistently for all time-based habits (not only a special-cased habit name).

quotes:
The volume of workouts/ reps / time etc 
It should display the total volume of all the reps and time 
Yes

acceptanceCriteria: Given a habit with unitType = "reps" and a per-completion volume of 10, and 3 completed days in the selected month, the UI shows a monthly total of 30 for that habit.

Given a habit with a numeric per-completion volume (e.g., workouts volume already expressed as weight×reps×sets per completion) and 4 completed days, the UI shows monthly total = per-completion volume × 4 for that habit.
Given a time-based habit with per-completion value stored as timeString "1:15" and 2 completed days, the UI shows monthly total "2:30" (seconds-accurate).
Given a time-based habit without timeString but with minutes stored, the UI still computes a correct monthly total and formats it as M:SS.
Monthly totals are correct immediately after toggling completion checkboxes (i.e., after React Query updates and re-render).

requirements.text: Add a selected-month aggregate total volume summary that sums volumes across all habits for the selected month and displays separate totals at minimum for: total reps (sum of per-habit monthly totals for unitType "reps"), total time (sum of per-habit monthly totals for unitType "time" in seconds, formatted as M:SS), and total workouts numeric volume (sum of per-habit monthly totals for workout-style numeric unit types if present). The summary must match the corrected per-habit totals from REQ-1.

quotes: It should display the total volume of all the reps and time

acceptanceCriteria: When multiple reps habits exist, the aggregate reps total equals the sum of each reps habit’s monthly total for the selected month.
When multiple time habits exist, the aggregate time total equals the sum of each time habit’s monthly total for the selected month, computed seconds-accurately when timeString is available.
If no habits exist for a category (e.g., no time habits), the aggregate summary displays 0 (or 0:00 for time) for that category.
Changing the selected month updates the aggregate totals to reflect the newly selected month.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any path listed in frontend.immutablePaths in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change the monthly progression/compounding rules for Plank/Squash or other habits beyond what is necessary to compute correct totals.
Do not introduce new backend canisters, external databases, or third-party integrations.
Do not change authentication behavior (Internet Identity).
